summary: End-to-end backend testing of ChemShield AI. 17/17 pytest tests pass covering health, JWT register/login/me, duplicate/invalid-credential errors, Google callback rejection of invalid session, scan create with real Gemini 3 Flash vision analysis (label photo), list/get/delete scans, own file download via Bearer and ?auth= query, 403 on cross-user file access, and stats summary. Fixed one production bug during testing: /api/auth/register and /api/auth/google/callback returned MongoDB ObjectId in response body causing 500 (jsonable_encoder crash). Added _id pop after insert_one on both paths.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line ~457: /api/files path ACL check uses `'/' + path` prefix search which is brittle; a user could craft a path containing another user's uid as a substring elsewhere. Consider strictly validating `path.startswith(f"{APP_NAME}/scans/{user['user_id']}/")` only.

Scan documents insert-then-return pattern: after `db.scans.insert_one(doc)` you pop `_id` before returning — good. Same pattern must be applied on any future insert (was missing on register/google-callback; now fixed).

STORAGE key init is process-global (`_storage_key`) with no refresh on 401; if the storage service rotates keys the backend will silently fail until restart. Consider retry-on-401 that calls init_storage(force=True).
Google OAuth cookie set with SameSite=None; Secure=True is correct, but no CSRF protection is applied to /api/auth/logout (cookie-only). Low risk given JWT primary path, but worth noting.
SYSTEM_PROMPT + Gemini call is fine, but analyze_with_gemini has no timeout wrapper — a hung LLM call will block the request for as long as the httpx default. Consider asyncio.wait_for.
No pagination on GET /api/scans beyond `limit=50` query — acceptable for MVP.
server.py is 490 lines — still under 700-line threshold, but auth/scans/storage could reasonably be split for maintainability.
test_credentials: demo@chemshield.ai / Demo@1234 (seeded on startup, verified working)
seed_data_creation: Tests dynamically register throwaway users (test_*@chemshield.ai, other_*@chemshield.ai) and one scan per run which is then deleted. Real Gemini vision analysis was invoked against a sample product photo downloaded to /tmp/label.jpg.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://chemshield-scan.preview.emergentagent.com). Sample image fetched to /tmp/label.jpg; if missing, tests will fail — re-fetch with `curl -s -o /tmp/label.jpg 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1585421514738-01798e348b17?w=800&q=60'`. Suite uses pytest-xdist loadscope; all scan-dependent tests are consolidated in class TestScansFilesStats so they run on the same worker. Fixed backend bug was ObjectId leaking into response of /api/auth/register and /api/auth/google/callback — pop `_id` after insert_one.
rca of the issue: Bug: /api/auth/register returned HTTP 500 for any new signup. RCA: motor's `insert_one(doc)` mutates the input dict in-place by injecting the generated `_id: ObjectId(...)`. The handler then returned `{"token": ..., "user": doc}` and FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId, raising `TypeError('ObjectId' object is not iterable)`. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with a fresh email → 500. Fix: added `doc.pop('_id', None)` after insert in /api/auth/register and after the new-user insert in /api/auth/google/callback. Verified with test_register_new_user (200) and test_07_other_user_forbidden (which now succeeds in registering a second user).
